topicTitle: 1.2 Ethical Considerations in the Production and Use of Chemical Substances
keyPoints: Identifies at least two CFC alternatives (HFCs, HFOs, hydrocarbons)
Discusses global warming potential of alternatives
modelAnswer: Alternatives to CFCs include Hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs), Hydrofluoroolefins (HFOs), and hydrocarbon-based refrigerants. HFCs have lower ozone depletion potential but still contribute to global warming. HFOs are more environmentally friendly with minimal ozone depletion and lower global warming potential. Hydrocarbon refrigerants are effective but flammable, requiring careful handling. HFOs represent the best balance between environmental protection and effectiveness.

explanation: Peroxyacetyl Nitrate (PAN) is an irritant that primarily affects the respiratory system and eyes. It causes inflammation of airways, reduces lung function, and triggers eye irritation in humans. PAN is a secondary pollutant formed in the troposphere through photochemical reactions, making it a significant component of photochemical smog that poses health risks to exposed populations.
